items.html: However, in the evening prayer, it is still the beginning of the night, and the dominion of the external forces has not strengthened, because until then it was day and Chesed and mercy prevailed in the world, and not all the Mochin of Katnut departed completely; but two levels remained in him: the first is the inner Mochin of the Katnut of Ima, which are fixed in him always and do not depart at any time, as mentioned. And also the encircling ones of the Katnut of Ima remained in him.
